seo_article: Latest updates on Sun World Ba Den MountainExplore Ba Den Mountain Cable CarWhat Makes Ba Den Mountain Cable Car Special?Stunning Cable Car Stations for Check-inExploring Ancient Temples on Ba Den MountainTallest Bronze Buddha Statue in AsiaCheck-in at the 986m LandmarkJoin Festivals and Visit the Dreamy Flower GardenHow to Get to Ba Den Mountain Cable CarMotorbikeTaxiBusImportant Tips for Visiting Ba Den Mountain Cable CarTheBa Den Mountain Cable Carsystem is one of the most modern cable car routes in Southeast Asia, transporting visitors from the mountain foot to the summit of Ba Den—the highest peak in Southern Vietnam. The journey takes only about 12 minutes, offering breathtaking panoramic views of Tay Ninh’s pristine forests, majestic hills, and sacred ancient temples.Ba Den Mountain Cable CarWhat Makes Ba Den Mountain Cable Car Special?Stunning Cable Car Stations for Check-inRiding theBa Den Mountain Cable Car, you will have the chance to admire and take photos at uniquely designed stations. With its modern and impressive architecture, this is a dream destination for photography lovers.The three cable car stations at Ba Den Mountain include:Ba Den Station:Known for its luxurious and contemporary design, Ba Den Station is recognized as the world's largest cable car station. With its spacious hall, airy atmosphere, and impressive artistic decorations, it’s a must-visit spot for Instagram-worthy photos.Chua Hang Station:Located midway up the mountain, Chua Hang Station features architecture inspired by mystical caves. Here, visitors can learn about Tay Ninh's history and culture. The station also houses the statue of Avalokiteshvara (Goddess of Mercy) and a miniature version of Buu Long Lake, creating a breathtaking scene.Van Son Station:Offering a panoramic view of Tay Ninh from above, Van Son Station showcases classic European-style architecture, resembling an ancient cathedral with intricate and colorful decorations. Don’t forget to capture some memorable photos when visiting!Van Son Station with its charming European-style architecture, loved by photography enthusiastsExploring Ancient Temples on Ba Den MountainBeyond the stunning cable car stations, yourBa Den Mountain Cable Carticket also takes you to sacred and ancient temples such as Linh Son Phuoc Trung Temple, Ba Den Temple (dedicated to Linh Son Holy Mother), Linh Son Hoa Dong Temple, Linh Son Long Chau Temple (Chua Hang), and Quan Am Temple (Ba Co Cave). These temples offer visitors a peaceful retreat, perfect for praying and enjoying the serene atmosphere.Tallest Bronze Buddha Statue in AsiaOne of the highlights of theBa Den Mountain Cable Carexperience is the chance to admire and pray at the Tay Bo Da Son Buddha Statue—the tallest bronze Buddha statue in Asia, officially recognized by the Asia Book of Records. This spiritual site attracts pilgrims from all over Vietnam, symbolizing faith and devotion to Buddhism.Tay Bo Da Son Buddha StatueCheck-in at the 986m LandmarkA must-visit spot when taking theBa Den Mountain Cable Caris the 986m landmark, marking the exact height of Ba Den Mountain. This spot is a symbol of the visitor’s achievement after conquering over 1,000 steps. From here, you can enjoy a breathtaking view of Tay Ninh and experience the best cloud-hunting moments. Plan your cable car ride accordingly to catch the most stunning scenery!986m LandmarkJoin Festivals and Visit the Dreamy Flower GardenBa Den Mountain hosts several major festivals throughout the year. If you love cultural experiences and vibrant festivities, plan yourBa Den Mountain Cable Cartrip during these events. Some notable festivals include the Ba Den Spring Festival (from the 4th day of the Lunar New Year until the end of the month) and the Via Ba Festival (from the 3rd to the 6th of the 5th lunar month).Flower Garden on Ba Den Mountain PeakWhile visiting Ba Den Mountain, don’t miss the picturesque flower gardens at the summit. With fresh air and vibrant blossoms, this dreamy setting is often compared to the "Da Lat of Southeast Vietnam," making it a perfect spot for stunning check-ins.How to Get to Ba Den Mountain Cable CarYou can reach theBa Den Mountain Cable Carby various means:MotorbikeMotorbikes are the most popular and convenient mode of transport in Tay Ninh. The distance from the city center to the cable car station is about 11km. You can take National Highway 22A or Boi Loi Road, which takes approximately 20-30 minutes.TaxiTaxis are a quick and convenient option. You can hail a taxi from anywhere in Tay Ninh City, with fares ranging from VND 150,000 to 200,000.BusThis is the most economical option, though it takes longer. Buses will drop you off at the base of Ba Den Mountain, from where you can walk or take a motorbike taxi to the cable car area. You can catch Bus No. 01 from Tay Ninh Bus Station, with a fare of VND 7,000 per person.Important Tips for Visiting Ba Den Mountain Cable CarCheck the weather forecast and choose a sunny day for the best experience.Bring sunscreen, hats, and water.Wear comfortable shoes for easy movement.Carry snacks and drinks, as they are not sold on the cable car.Keep an eye on children during the trip.Book your Ba Den Mountain Cable Car tickets on Traveloka for the best deals!
